section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Liestal; other communes differ) and church tax
label: Cantonal multiplier
value: No multiple: the tariff gives the cantonal tax (ESTV note 3)
note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Liestal; other communes in Basel-Landschaft set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)
